plan: A very aggressive marksman who shoots twice after every spell and dominates the early game.
aSurveiller: His E (Relentless Pursuit). His dash comes back very quickly: he can reach you or escape several times.
contrer: Avoid trading early: he is very strong early.
His damage drops in the late game: drag the game out.
Don't stay in the line of his R: step out to the side.
forces: Very strong in the early game.

sorts.P: After each spell, his next attack fires twice.
sorts.E: Short dash that comes back fast.
sorts.R: Barrage of bullets in a line.

momentFort: Very strong in the early game, then less and less effective as the game goes on.
